description: Search Spanish companies (BORME / Registro Mercantil) by name, alias or exact CIF. ALWAYS the first step: it returns the `slug` that every other company tool needs, plus CIF, province, CNAE code, share capital (cents), first/last BORME appearance and number of registry acts. Name search is by name prefix, so start with the distinctive start of the legal name (e.g. "Telefónica de España"), not a descriptive phrase. Only legal entities are returned; DNI/NIE never match. Paginate with offset (max 1000).

q.description: Company name (or the start of it), alias or exact CIF, e.g. "Telefónica de España" or "A82018474". Natural-person identifiers (DNI/NIE) always return zero results.

name: borme_search_companies
